name: checkout-flow
title: Checkout Flow
description: A cursor-driven checkout card: pick the yearly plan, type a card number, accept the terms, pay, and a toast confirms.
useWhen: Demoing a SaaS payment or upgrade UX end to end with cursor navigation and a toast confirmation.
A product video needs a complete purchase journey (plan, card, pay, success) in one scene.
Showing the full checkout funnel without assembling the primitives.
avoidWhen: You only need a payment form without cursor animation: compose field, input and button.
The flow is a multi-step onboarding, not payment: use onboarding-stepper-flow.
You need custom timing control over individual steps: orchestrate the primitives.
author: Remocn

variables.label: Description
variables.default: Complete your purchase to unlock every feature.

variables.label: Plans
variables.description: JSON array of {"value","label"}; the cursor picks the second one.

variables.label: Card number
variables.description: Placeholder, and the number that types itself.

variables.label: Terms label
variables.default: I accept the terms and conditions

variables.label: Speed
variables.description: Playback speed of the scripted interaction. 2 plays it twice as fast and holds the end.

variables.label: Transparent
variables.description: Leave the background clear so the control sits over your own scene.
